$comment: Member kinds this lexicon supplies to a chant workspace (#3179). chant reads this file as data and never imports the lexicon. A Helm chart is a directory with a Chart.yaml, and Chart.yaml is the member's own file, checked against schemas/chart.schema.json. The graph block (#3179) reads a chart through helm template (src/workspace-member.ts); with no helm binary the member says rendered: false on meta.helmMember.

kinds.name: helm-chart
kinds.description: a Helm chart, with a Chart.yaml in its directory
